reasoning: Hantavirus vaccines are only in early clinical research; none are in Phase 3 trials. Full FDA approval by end of 2026 would require completing Phase 3 and regulatory review within ~18 months, which is implausible. The market significantly overprices the likelihood of a sudden vaccine approval.
evidence_points: No hantavirus vaccine has entered large-scale Phase 3 clinical trials globally.
Hantavirus infections are rare, limiting commercial incentive and urgency for accelerated development.
FDA full approval timeline for a new vaccine typically takes years beyond Phase 2, with no emergency authorization pathway currently active.
sources_consulted: FDA Vaccines Licensed for Use in the United States list
ClinicalTrials.gov search for hantavirus vaccine Phase 2/3 trials
